description: 《Believer》描寫一個人經歷痛苦、挫折與自我懷疑後，逐漸找到信念與力量的成長過程。歌中的主角從年少時便承受傷害，也曾因外界的批評與壓力感到憤怒和迷惘，但他拒絕讓別人決定自己的價值與未來。他將內心的痛苦透過文字與音樂表達出來，並從一次又一次的打擊中學會堅強。歌曲以火焰、子彈與暴雨等意象，象徵人生中的挑戰，以及壓抑已久的情緒終於得到釋放。最終，《Believer》傳達的是勇氣、成長與自我信念：即使傷痛曾經令人崩潰，我們仍然可以選擇如何面對過去，將挫折轉化為前進的動力，重新掌握自己的人生。

vocabulary.usage: 開始說明事情、安排工作或提醒別人先做什麼時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「First things first」？
options: I bought first things first at the shop for five dollars.
First things first, let’s find the missing cat before we make dinner.
My dog is first things first because it has four legs.
Please first things first the window before you leave.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：這不是能買的商品。可說 I bought a book.
正確：先找貓，再做晚餐，符合「先處理重要的事」。
錯誤：不能用來形容狗的外表。可說 My dog is small.
錯誤：這不是動詞。可說 Please close the window.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：先找貓，再做晚餐，符合「先處理重要的事」。

optionExplanations: 錯誤。醫師可以記錄血管狀況，但不會把一條血管「寫在」報告上。
錯誤。vein 不是交通工具，不能載計程車穿越城市。
正確。抽血前找到靜脈，符合實際用法。
錯誤。機械零件通常不稱為 vein；此處應用 pipe 或 wire。
questions.explanation: 正確。抽血前找到靜脈，符合實際用法。

questions.word: drive
questions.meaning: 動力；強烈的企圖心
questions.usage: 用來形容讓一個人持續努力、實現目標的內在動機；這裡不是開車。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「drive」（本題指定意思）？
options: Her drive to improve helped her practise every day.
He put his drive on the shelf beside the plates.
My drive was parked outside the library all night.
The chef added some drive to the soup for flavour.
optionExplanations: 正確。指努力進步的內在動力，使用自然。
錯誤。抽象的動力不能像物品一樣放在架上。
錯誤。車子應說 car；此處的 drive 不是可停放的車輛。
錯誤。drive 不是食材，無法拿來調味。
questions.explanation: 正確。指努力進步的內在動力，使用自然。

questions.word: spirit
questions.meaning: 精神；意志；心靈
questions.usage: 談一個人的精神狀態、勇氣或內在力量；不同語境也可能指靈魂。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「spirit」（本題指定意思）？
options: We measured her spirit in metres during science class.
She folded her spirit into a paper plane for school.
The pilot checked her spirit before the plane took off.
His spirit stayed strong during the difficult season.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。精神不是用公尺測量的物理長度。
錯誤。精神不能真的摺成紙飛機。
錯誤。飛行前檢查的應是 equipment 或 instruments，不是精神。
正確。面對艱難時仍保有堅強意志，使用自然。
questions.explanation: 正確。面對艱難時仍保有堅強意志，使用自然。

questions.word: dove
questions.meaning: 鴿子；常象徵和平
questions.usage: 談鳥類、藝術或和平象徵時使用；不要把所有 dove 都直接解釋成宗教象徵。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「dove」（本題指定意思）？
options: The teacher dove three problems on the blackboard.
The dove arrived late because the road had traffic.
We wore a dove around our feet to keep them warm.
A white dove flew above the crowd at the ceremony.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。這裡需要 wrote；dove 不是「寫」的動詞。
錯誤。鴿子能飛，不會因為道路塞車而自然解釋遲到。
錯誤。鴿子不是鞋襪或保暖衣物。
正確。典禮上有鴿子飛過人群，實際鳥類與象徵意義皆自然。
questions.explanation: 正確。典禮上有鴿子飛過人群，實際鳥類與象徵意義皆自然。

questions.word: choke
questions.meaning: 窒息；哽住；喘不過氣
questions.usage: 呼吸受阻，或因情緒緊張而說不出話時使用；也可能比喻壓力。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「choke」（本題指定意思）？
options: The singer choked the microphone to make it louder.
He choked on a piece of food and needed help.
I choked my homework after the football match.
Our train choked at the platform before leaving.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。要讓麥克風更大聲應說 turn up，不是 choke。
正確。吃東西噎住、呼吸受阻，符合 choke on 的意思。
錯誤。完成作業應說 did 或 finished，不是 choked。
錯誤。火車停在月台應說 stopped，不是 choked。
questions.explanation: 正確。吃東西噎住、呼吸受阻，符合 choke on 的意思。

questions.word: ashes
questions.meaning: 灰燼；燃燒後剩下的粉灰
questions.usage: 談木柴、紙張或其他材料燃燒後的殘留物，也可有象徵性的意思。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「ashes」（本題指定意思）？
options: The dancer wore ashes as two shiny new shoes.
The gardener planted ashes to grow three new trees.
My ashes called me during the lunch break.
Cold ashes remained in the fireplace the next morning.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。灰燼不能自然指兩隻新鞋。
錯誤。灰燼可作土壤改良材料，但「種下灰燼來長樹」說法不自然。
錯誤。灰燼不會打電話，不能當作人。
正確。壁爐燃燒後留下冷灰燼，使用自然。
questions.explanation: 正確。壁爐燃燒後留下冷灰燼，使用自然。

questions.word: drown
questions.meaning: 溺水；淹沒；（比喻）被情緒壓倒
questions.usage: 談人在水中無法呼吸；也可表示被工作、噪音或感受淹沒。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「drown」（本題指定意思）？
options: The new swimmer nearly drowned in the deep pool.
He drowned his lunch in the bicycle after school.
She drowned the meeting at exactly nine thirty.
The towel drowned the homework before dinner.
optionExplanations: 正確。游泳者差點在深池溺水，符合 drown 的核心意思。
錯誤。此處無合理語義；自行車不是淹沒午餐的容器。
錯誤。drown 不表示開始或安排會議。
錯誤。毛巾不會自然用 drown 表示把作業淹沒。
questions.explanation: 正確。游泳者差點在深池溺水，符合 drown 的核心意思。

questions.word: ebb and flow
questions.meaning: 起伏；消長；潮起潮落
questions.usage: 形容潮水、感情、人氣或工作量時高時低、來回變化；歌中使用 ebbing and flowing。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「ebb and flow」（本題指定意思）？
options: The dog ebbed and flowed the door to leave the room.
We bought an ebb and flow at the station for lunch.
The ebb and flow of tourists changes through the year.
Her printer began to ebb and flow in bright green ink.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。不能用這個片語表示狗開門或走出去。
錯誤。這是變化的過程，不是能買來吃的食物。
正確。旅客人數隨季節增減，符合「消長」。
錯誤。印表機的噴墨行為不自然稱為 ebb and flow。
questions.explanation: 正確。旅客人數隨季節增減，符合「消長」。

questions.word: inhibited
questions.meaning: 拘謹的；受抑制的；放不開的
questions.usage: 指人因害羞或不自在而無法自由表達，或某種反應、過程受到抑制。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「inhibited」（本題指定意思）？
options: My shoes were inhibited under the kitchen table.
She felt inhibited and barely spoke at the party.
The concert was inhibited because the singer wore blue.
He inhibited his sandwich before the morning lesson.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。鞋子放在桌下應用 were left；inhibited 不描述位置。
正確。她在派對上拘謹、幾乎不說話，用法自然。
錯誤。穿藍衣服不是音樂會「被抑制」的合理原因。
錯誤。inhibit 不表示吃或準備三明治。
questions.explanation: 正確。她在派對上拘謹、幾乎不說話，用法自然。

questions.word: grace
questions.meaning: 恩典；恩惠（也可表示優雅）
questions.usage: 在宗教或文學語境中可表示不必然應得的恩惠；其他語境可形容優雅。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「grace」（本題指定意思）？
options: She wore grace on both feet during the race.
The train arrived by grace at platform five.
They survived the storm by the grace of God.
The musician bought three graces at the ticket desk.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。grace 不是可以穿在雙腳上的鞋襪。
錯誤。火車到月台不會自然用 by grace 表示時間或地點。
正確。表示相信在上天恩典下平安度過暴風雨，符合本題的恩典義。
錯誤。grace 不是一般可數的票券或商品。
questions.explanation: 正確。表示相信在上天恩典下平安度過暴風雨，符合本題的恩典義。

questions.word: rain down
questions.meaning: 大量落下；接連而來
questions.usage: 形容雨、物品或批評大量從上方落下或接踵而來；語境可為字面或比喻。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「rain down」（本題指定意思）？
options: We rained down the bus to reach the museum early.
Confetti rained down on the winners after the show.
The singer rained down her shoes before the concert.
He rained down his breakfast using a small fork.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。搭車應說 took the bus，不是 rain down。
正確。彩紙在表演後大量灑落在得獎者身上，使用自然。
錯誤。rain down 不表示穿鞋或放鞋。
錯誤。rain down 不能表示吃早餐。
questions.explanation: 正確。彩紙在表演後大量灑落在得獎者身上，使用自然。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: First things first — 先講最重要的事
questions.meaning: 先提出最重要、最緊急的事情。
questions.usage: 安排工作次序，或在說話前指出優先事項。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: First things first, we should buy ten hats because the swimming pool has no water.
First things first, we can put the last step before every other step.
First things first, we need to go home after we have already gone home.
First things first, we need to find the missing child before the show starts.
optionExplanations: 泳池沒水應先處理水的問題，買帽子不是合理的首要任務。
說第一件事，卻要求把最後一步放在最前面，次序互相矛盾。
人已經回家，卻把回家當作尚未完成的第一件事。
先找走失的小孩，真正符合先處理最重要事情的意思。
questions.example: First things first, we need to find the keys.
questions.explanation: 先找走失的小孩，真正符合先處理最重要事情的意思。

questions.word: I'ma + base verb — 非正式未來打算
questions.meaning: 口語中表示「我要／我打算」，接近 I’m going to。
questions.usage: 辨認流行歌曲中的極口語未來表達；正式或一般課堂寫作用 I’m going to。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: I'ma happy about the game tomorrow.
I'ma show you my drawing after lunch.
I'ma to open the shop at six.
I'ma going to help you with the boxes.
optionExplanations: I’ma 後面不能直接接 happy；應使用 I’m going to be happy。
I’ma 後接原形 show，清楚表達接下來要做的事。
I’ma 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。
I’ma 已包含 going to 的意思，不再加 going to。
questions.example: I'ma tell you the plan.
questions.explanation: I’ma 後接原形 show，清楚表達接下來要做的事。

questions.word: all + the + plural noun + modifier — 限定「全部」
questions.meaning: 說明某個明確群組中的全部人或物。
questions.usage: 要表達指定範圍內「一個也不漏」時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: She ate all the cakes on the plate, but every cake was still there.
He took all the chairs in the room, but left half of them there.
The guide counted all the birds in the garden, including the little ones.
I read all the pages in this book, but I have not opened it.
optionExplanations: 說吃光所有蛋糕，卻又說蛋糕全在盤上，互相矛盾。
宣稱拿走全部椅子，卻留下了一半，與 all 矛盾。
清點花園裡的所有鳥，包括小鳥，符合指定範圍的「全部」。
連書都未打開，不可能已讀完全部頁面。
questions.cue: all the words inside my head
questions.example: She read all the notes on the wall.
questions.explanation: 清點花園裡的所有鳥，包括小鳥，符合指定範圍的「全部」。

questions.word: be fired up — 情緒激昂
questions.meaning: 表示很興奮、有衝勁；也可能表示激動或生氣。
questions.usage: 有人準備迎接比賽、表演或挑戰而情緒高漲時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: The young players are fired up and ready for their first match.
The fridge is fired up because the milk is cold.
The team is fired up, so nobody wants to play and everyone is asleep.
The robot is fired up because its battery is a sandwich.
optionExplanations: 球員興奮準備首場比賽，正是 fired up 的自然用法。
冰箱的冷牛奶不能合理說明人類的興奮或鬥志。
說球隊充滿幹勁，卻全都睡著而且不想比賽，前後衝突。
把三明治當電池，並非合理的激昂情緒情境。
questions.example: The dancers are fired up before the show.
questions.explanation: 球員興奮準備首場比賽，正是 fired up 的自然用法。

questions.word: be tired of + noun / -ing — 厭倦
questions.meaning: 對重複的事情感到厭倦，想要改變。
questions.usage: 表示做某件事太多次，或長期忍受同一情況。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: I am tired of to hear that song every morning.
The gardener is tired of because the flowers are yellow.
The cook is tired of making the same soup each day, so she tries a new dish.
She is tired of her new bike because she has never seen it or used it.
optionExplanations: of 是介系詞，後面要用 hearing，不能接 to hear。
tired of 後缺少具體事物或 -ing 活動。
每天煮一樣的湯令廚師厭倦，於是改做新菜，動機合理。
未見過也未用過單車，不足以支持「因反覆接觸而厭倦」的描述。
questions.example: We are tired of waiting in long lines.
questions.explanation: 每天煮一樣的湯令廚師厭倦，於是改做新菜，動機合理。

questions.word: the way (that) + clause — 事情的方式
questions.meaning: 談某件事發生或運作的方式、狀態。
questions.usage: 解釋自己喜歡、不喜歡或注意到的做事方式。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: I like the way that my clock is a purple sandwich.
I like the way that the singer speak to the crowd.
I like the way the new coach explains each game, so I understand it better.
The way that he opens the gate is not a way because he opens the gate.
optionExplanations: 時鐘不是三明治，內容難以作為合理的做事方式。
單數 singer 在一般現在式要用 speaks。
教練的解釋方式讓人更明白，比較自然且符合句型功能。
把具體方式說成「不是方式」，但同時又描述它，意思自我否定。
questions.cue: the way that things have been
questions.example: I like the way that she helps the children.
questions.explanation: 教練的解釋方式讓人更明白，比較自然且符合句型功能。

questions.word: present perfect: have/has + past participle — 到現在的狀態
questions.meaning: 從過去至今與現在有關的情況或經驗。
questions.usage: 談過去開始而仍與現在有關的經歷時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: She have lived here for five years.
I have finished the letter next week.
The shop has opened tomorrow, so we went there yesterday.
We have known our neighbour for years, so we know her well.
optionExplanations: she 要接 has，而不是 have。
next week 是未來，不能自然地配搭 have finished 表示已完成。
明天才開幕與昨天已光顧的時間安排相衝突。
多年認識鄰居，並且現在仍相熟，符合現在完成式的時間關係。
questions.example: The road has been quiet all week.
questions.explanation: 多年認識鄰居，並且現在仍相熟，符合現在完成式的時間關係。

questions.word: Don’t you + base verb — 加重語氣的禁止
questions.meaning: 帶強烈情緒的「你可別……」，比普通 Don’t 更有力。
questions.usage: 明確警告或強烈禁止某種行為；注意語氣可能較兇。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: Don't you be the winner yesterday!
Don't you step onto the wet floor! It is not safe.
Don't you to open that box!
Don't you tells everyone my secret!
optionExplanations: 這是禁止句，不適合用來要求改變昨天已發生的結果。
提醒對方不要踏上濕地板，符合強烈警告的功能。
Don’t you 後直接接原形 open，不加 to。
tell 才是原形，不能用 tells。
questions.example: Don't you touch that wet paint!
questions.explanation: 提醒對方不要踏上濕地板，符合強烈警告的功能。

questions.word: tell + person + embedded what-clause — 告訴某人內容
questions.meaning: 把「甚麼內容」放入較大的句子中。
questions.usage: 要求別人說明其想法、見聞或選擇時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: Please tell me what you found in the old box.
Please tell what you found me in the box.
Please tell me what did you find in the old box.
Please tell me what finding you the box.
optionExplanations: 間接問句用 what + 主詞 + 動詞，清楚詢問盒內發現的東西。
tell 後人與內容的位置混亂，應說 tell me what you found。
間接問句不用 did you find 的直接問句語序。
what 後不是完整自然的子句，無法表達想問的內容。
questions.example: Please tell me what you saw.
questions.explanation: 間接問句用 what + 主詞 + 動詞，清楚詢問盒內發現的東西。

questions.word: think + (that) + could + base verb — 推測可能性
questions.meaning: 表達某人認為一件事有可能發生或做得到。
questions.usage: 談別人對自己能力、可能身份或未來選擇的看法時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: I think he could to open the gate.
Our coach thinks I could join the team because I practise a lot.
I think that Mia could flies the kite today.
She thinks her fish could drive the train to work.
optionExplanations: could 後直接接 open，不用 to。
教練根據練習表現推測可能入隊，符合 think + could 的語意。
could 後要接原形 fly，不能用 flies。
魚開火車是刻意荒誕的可能性，與現實情境不符。
questions.cue: you think that I could be

pattern.text: 原形動詞 （方括號內內容可替換）

questions.example: I think she could lead the group.
questions.explanation: 教練根據練習表現推測可能入隊，符合 think + could 的語意。

questions.word: be the one + modifier — 指出特定的人
questions.meaning: 指出某個人正是負責或符合描述的那一位。
questions.usage: 想釐清誰負責、誰做了某事或誰在特定位置時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: He is the one at the front, but nobody is standing at the front and he is at home.
She is the one with the blue hat, and nobody is wearing a hat.
The captain is the one in charge, but he has no job on the boat.
I am the one who made the cake, so please ask me how I made it.
optionExplanations: 指出站在最前面的人，卻說他在家，位置衝突。
指定戴藍帽的人，卻說現場無人戴帽，描述不符。
說船長負責，卻又說他在船上毫無職責，身份互相矛盾。
用 who made the cake 指出做蛋糕的人，並提供一致的後續情境。
questions.cue: I’m the one at the sail
questions.example: She is the one in the red coat.
questions.explanation: 用 who made the cake 指出做蛋糕的人，並提供一致的後續情境。

questions.word: be the master of + noun — 掌握某事
questions.meaning: 用比喻或字面意思表示掌控、精通某個領域。
questions.usage: 強調自己能掌握某件事，而不完全由別人決定時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了此句型及其功能？
options: She is the master of yesterday tomorrow.
The master of my shoes is seven o’clock.
He masters of his lunch with a fork.
She is the master of her own time; she makes her plans each morning.
optionExplanations: 把昨天和明天混成沒有意義的掌握對象，無法說明能力。
時間不是這裡可自然掌握鞋子的「主人」。
master of 作名詞結構需有 be 或其他適當動詞，這裡搭配不完整。
能自己安排每日時間，符合掌握自己生活的比喻。
questions.example: She is the master of her own plans.
questions.explanation: 能自己安排每日時間，符合掌握自己生活的比喻。
